scope: Q11-Q20 ask about captured NatMed annotations, not personal recommendations, product applicability, all literature, or complete monograph extraction.
unit: One source claim ID with its structured fields and supporting spans. Shared excerpts do not merge distinct population/dose claims or count as independent corroboration.
relevance: Include annotations of the requested type from the pinned source monograph. Explicit general-context annotations below are optional supporting context rather than primary recall units. Other claim types from that monograph are excluded from the primary set, not declared clinically irrelevant in all contexts.

qualifications: Separate drug, supplement and laboratory-test interactions using source section.
Keep rating, severity, occurrence and evidence statements distinct; missing ratings stay null.
Retain theoretical, conflicting-evidence, route, dose and formulation qualifications in the original excerpt.
Keep each population/age band, source unit and oral route; preserve original dual-unit text without new conversion.
Separate RDA, adequate intake, minimum intake, source-attributed recommendations, upper limits and administration cautions.
The eighteen annotations share two source blocks; do not merge their different structured dose/population fields.
Null duration or frequency remains unknown. Do not turn a captured upper limit into a recommended dose.
Treat the general statement that recommendations vary as optional context, not a numeric-dose answer.
Include condition-specific precautions alongside general, pregnancy and lactation statements.
Preserve mixed oral/topical context and duration limits; a rating does not apply universally.
Preserve theoretical language and uncertainty; do not fill unknown structured populations or doses from assumptions.
Keep short-/long-term, dose, route, pregnancy and child statements separate even when populations repeat.
Retain uncertain/conflicting findings and clinician-supervised non-oral context.
Condition-specific precautions are relevant to this source-safety question; no personal safety determination.
Display source title Fish Oil: the Omega-3 topic does not establish applicability to all omega-3 materials, ALA, or branded products.
Separate drug/supplement partners and preserve theoretical/conflicting or unlikely-clinical-effect qualifications.
Do not replace MINOR/MODERATE interaction ratings with severity, or populate missing supplement ratings.
Return negative and insufficient-evidence ratings as well as positive ones.
Bind every indication to its own rating, including rating headings outside the excerpt.
Retain oral, injection, topical and other route distinctions; formulation/combination evidence is not universal supplement evidence.
Do not infer independent vitamin B12 efficacy from combination-only studies or a biochemical endpoint.
Separate oral from intravenous/parenteral effects and retain case-report/observational and conflicting-evidence language.
Keep the General tolerability statement as optional context, not an adverse-event example.
Do not generalize intravenous effects to the selected oral product or interpret association as causation.
Retain theoretical, animal/in-vitro and conflicting evidence qualifiers; source interaction statements are not all proven clinical events.
Keep turmeric/curcumin, formulation, dose and bioavailability context in the original excerpt.
Distinguish partner classes from individual drugs and preserve null supplement ratings.
Display source title Lactobacillus acidophilus. This is not complete clinical evidence for all probiotics.
Retain strain, live/heat-killed status, oral/intravaginal route, population, product and combination context in each excerpt.
Include insufficient and negative evidence; preserve earlier-section rating anchors.
Do not promote combination evidence to an individual strain, all species, or a branded probiotic product.
Keep short-/long-term, child and pregnancy/lactation contexts separate.
Include bipolar, kidney and Parkinson-related condition statements without inferring product-specific applicability.
Preserve theoretical and caffeine-combination qualifications and null structured fields; do not create a personal safety recommendation.

supporting_context_exceptions.reason: General variability context without a numeric regimen; useful alongside primary dose-context records.

shared_exclusions: Other monographs or topics substituted by name similarity
Other claim types presented as primary answers without labeling their contextual role
Unattributed or incomplete paraphrases dropping uncertainty, formulation, route or population
Recommendations or product-level conclusions not established by these source annotations
